VI. Conclusion
Understanding wire types helps electricians:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      * Choose the right wire for the environment

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      * Comply with electrical codes

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      * Ensure long-lasting and safe installations

Mastery of wire types like THHN, NM-B, UF-B, and MC is fundamental for any project.





Lecture Notes: Conduits – EMT, PVC, Flexible Metal
________________


I. Introduction to Electrical Conduits
Electrical conduits are protective tubing systems used to route and shield electrical wiring from physical damage, moisture, corrosion, and interference.
Functions of Conduits:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         * Protect wires from mechanical damage

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         * Organize and route wiring

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         * Ensure electrical safety and grounding

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         * Meet local and national code requirements (e.g., NEC)

________________


II. Types of Conduits
We will focus on three common types:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            1. EMT (Electrical Metallic Tubing)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            2. PVC (Polyvinyl Chloride) Conduit

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            3. Flexible Metal Conduit (FMC and LFMC)

________________


III. EMT – Electrical Metallic Tubing
Overview:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               * Also known as "thin-wall" conduit

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               * Made of galvanized steel or aluminum

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               * Lightweight and easy to bend (with a hand bender)

Key Features:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Rigid but lighter than other metal conduits

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Provides mechanical protection

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Not threaded – uses compression or set-screw fittings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Good for indoor dry locations

Pros:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Inexpensive

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Easy to install and modify

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Provides grounding path

Cons:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        * Can rust if not protected

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        * Not for wet/corrosive environments without extra treatment

Common Uses:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           * Commercial buildings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           * Exposed indoor wiring

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           * Embedded in walls

________________


IV. PVC Conduit (Schedule 40 and Schedule 80)
Overview:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Made from rigid plastic

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Non-metallic, corrosion-resistant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Comes in Schedule 40 (standard wall) and Schedule 80 (thicker wall)

Key Features:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * Can be used above or below ground

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * Joints made with solvent cement (glue)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * Lightweight and non-conductive

Pros:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * Corrosion- and moisture-resistant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * Inexpensive

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * Good for underground and outdoor applications

Cons:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       * Not grounding path – requires a separate ground wire

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       * Can become brittle in cold temperatures

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       * Limited to non-hazardous locations

Common Uses:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          * Underground service entrances

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          * Outdoor lighting circuits

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          * Agricultural and industrial settings

________________


V. Flexible Metal Conduit (FMC)
Overview:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             * Also called "Greenfield"

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             * Made of spiral-wound metal (steel or aluminum)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             * Flexible – can bend around obstacles

Key Features:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                * No bending tools needed

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                * Comes with fittings for easy connection

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                * Can be cut with a hacksaw

Pros:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   * Ideal for tight spaces and retrofit jobs

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   * Provides limited vibration protection

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   * Can be grounded through its metal sheath

Cons:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      * Limited protection against moisture

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      * Not suitable for corrosive or outdoor wet environments

Common Uses:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         * Connection to motors, transformers, and HVAC units

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         * Indoor installations with movement or vibration

________________


VI. Liquidtight Flexible Metal Conduit (LFMC)
Overview:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Flexible metal conduit with an outer plastic jacket

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Water-resistant – can be used in wet and damp locations

Key Features:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               * Combines flexibility with moisture protection

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               * Often used with gasketed connectors

Common Uses:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Outdoor AC units

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Car washes

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Industrial areas exposed to moisture
                https://youtu.be/OkS8f7ODIxk

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * EMT: NEC Article 358

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        * Proper support spacing

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        * Conduit fill limits

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        * Bending radius requirements

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        * Approved fittings and connectors

________________


IX. Summary
Each type of conduit serves specific purposes:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           * EMT: Lightweight metal, used indoors

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           * PVC: Durable plastic, ideal for underground and wet locations

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           * FMC/LFMC: Flexible options for movement, tight bends, and vibration areas

Electricians must choose the right conduit based on the environment, code, and application to ensure a safe, durable, and code-compliant installation.




Cable Trays and Raceways
________________


I. Introduction
Cable trays and raceways are mechanical support systems used to organize, protect, and route electrical cables and wires. They provide alternatives to conduits for certain environments, especially where large volumes of wiring are involved.
Purpose:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Ensure safe routing of electrical and communication cables

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Provide physical protection

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Simplify maintenance and future expansion

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Maintain compliance with codes (e.g., NEC, NFPA)

________________


II. Cable Trays
Definition:
Cable trays are rigid structural systems used to support insulated electrical cables, power distribution cables, and communication wiring.
________________


Types of Cable Trays:
Type
	Description
	Applications
	Ladder Tray
	Side rails with rungs; open-bottom structure
	Common in industrial facilities
	Solid Bottom Tray
	Enclosed bottom; protects from dust and EMI
	Sensitive data or communication cables
	Trough Tray
	Solid side rails with ventilated bottom
	General control and signal cable routing
	Wire Mesh Tray
	Formed from steel wire mesh; lightweight
	Light-duty cabling like IT networks
	Channel Tray
	Single solid channel; for minimal cabling
	Short runs and branch circuits
	________________


Materials Used:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * Galvanized steel

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * Aluminum

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * Stainless steel

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * Fiberglass-reinforced plastic (FRP)

Advantages:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * Easy to install and modify

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * Excellent cable ventilation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * High load-bearing capacity

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * Reduces need for multiple conduits

Limitations:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       * May require fireproofing

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       * More exposed than conduit

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       * Aesthetically not suitable for finished spaces

________________

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          * NEC Article 392: Covers installation, sizing, fill limits, and support intervals for cable trays.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                * Full cable protection
