        Sizing and Derating Conductors
________________


I. Introduction
Proper sizing and derating of conductors ensures that electrical wires can carry current without overheating, voltage drop, or code violations. This topic is vital for all electricians and electrical designers.
________________


II. Conductor Sizing
Definition:
Conductor sizing refers to selecting the appropriate wire size (gauge) to safely carry the intended electrical current.
Key Factors:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               1. Ampacity – Maximum current a conductor can carry continuously without exceeding its temperature rating.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               2. Voltage drop – Acceptable voltage loss over the length of the wire.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               3. Load type – Continuous or non-continuous load.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               4. Length of run – Longer runs may require upsizing.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               5. Ambient temperature

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               6. Number of current-carrying conductors in a raceway or cable

________________


Standard Wire Sizes (AWG – American Wire Gauge):
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Common sizes: 14 AWG (15A), 12 AWG (20A), 10 AWG (30A), 8 AWG (40A), 6 AWG (55A)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Smaller number = thicker wire = higher ampacity

________________


NEC Guidelines for Sizing:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Refer to NEC Table 310.16 for ampacity values of conductors

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * For continuous loads:


Conductor ampacity must be ≥ 125% of the continuous load (NEC 210.19(A)(1)(a))


________________


Example Calculation (Basic):
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        * Load: 30 amps (continuous)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        * Required ampacity: 30 × 1.25 = 37.5 amps

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        * Use 8 AWG copper (40A) or larger depending on other factors

________________


III. Derating Conductors
Definition:
Derating is the reduction of a conductor’s ampacity based on external conditions that affect heat dissipation.
________________


Reasons for Derating:
Factor
	Why It Affects Ampacity
	Ambient Temperature
	Higher temps = more heat = reduced capacity
	Number of Conductors
	More wires = more heat buildup
	Conduit Fill
	Limited heat dissipation
	Installation Conditions
	In walls, ceilings, attics, etc.
	________________


1. Ambient Temperature Correction (NEC Table 310.15(B)(1)):
Temperature (°C)
	Correction Factor
	30°C (86°F)
	1.00 (no derating)
	40°C (104°F)
	0.91
	50°C (122°F)
	0.82
	Multiply ampacity by the factor for elevated ambient temperature.
________________


2. Conductor Quantity Derating (NEC Table 310.15(C)(1)):
Number of Current-Carrying Conductors
	Derating Factor
	4–6
	80%
	7–9
	70%
	10–20
	50%
	Note: Ground wires are not counted as current-carrying conductors.
________________


Example Derating Calculation:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           * 6 current-carrying 12 AWG THHN wires in a conduit at 40°C ambient.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           * Base ampacity from NEC Table 310.16: 30A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           * Ambient temp correction factor (40°C): 0.91

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           * Conductor count correction: 0.80

Total derated ampacity = 30A × 0.91 × 0.80 = 21.84A
So, 12 AWG cannot be used for a 20A continuous load in this scenario. Use a larger conductor.
________________


IV. Voltage Drop Considerations
Definition:
Voltage drop is the loss of voltage due to resistance over the length of the wire.
NEC Recommendation:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Max 3% for branch circuits

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Max 5% total (feeder + branch)

Correction:
Use larger wire sizes to compensate for long distances.
________________


V. Tools & Resources for Sizing/Derating
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * NEC Code Book: Especially Article 310 and related tables

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * Voltage Drop Calculators

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * Ampacity Charts

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * Load Calculators

________________


VI. Summary Table
Parameter
	Influences
	Correction Action
	Load size
	Determines base ampacity
	Select correct wire size
	Ambient temp
	High = lower ampacity
	Apply temperature derating
	Wire quantity
	More wires = heat
	Apply conductor derating
	Distance
	Long runs = voltage drop
	Upsize wire
	Location
	Ceiling, conduit, etc.
	May affect derating rules
	________________


VII. Final Notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * Never undersize conductors – risk of fire and failure

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * Follow NEC tables and manufacturer’s specifications

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * Always consider future expansion, not just current load

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * Confirm with licensed professional/electrical engineer if in doubt






Wire Pulling Techniques
________________


I. Introduction
Wire pulling is the process of installing electrical conductors (wires or cables) through a conduit, raceway, or building structure. Proper techniques reduce the risk of conductor damage, ensure code compliance, and improve efficiency on the job.
________________


II. Objectives of Proper Wire Pulling
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       * Prevent wire insulation damage

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       * Minimize friction during installation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       * Avoid conductor stretching or breakage

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       * Maintain safety and efficiency

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       * Comply with the National Electrical Code (NEC)

________________


III. Pre-Pull Preparation
1. Planning the Pull
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          * Review the wiring diagram and conduit layout

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          * Measure conduit lengths and calculate the number of bends

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          * Determine wire type, size, and length

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          * Identify pull points and termination locations

2. Inspect Conduit Path
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             * Check for blockages, sharp bends, moisture, or debris

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             * Verify that all conduit connections are tight and reamed

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             * Ensure total bends do not exceed 360° between pull points (NEC rule)

3. Select Pulling Equipment
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                * Fish tape (for short runs)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                * Pull cords or ropes (for medium runs)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                * Mechanical wire pullers (for long or heavy runs)

________________


IV. Common Wire Pulling Tools
Tool
	Use
	Fish Tape
	Pushes through conduit to attach and pull wire
	Pull Line/Twine
	Lightweight line for pulling wires or cables
	Wire Lubricant
	Reduces friction during pull
	Cable Puller
	Motorized device for heavy cables
	Conduit Bender
	Ensures smooth bends in conduit
	Measuring Tape
	For determining wire length
	________________


V. Wire Pulling Techniques
1. Manual Pulling
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   * Used for short runs or small wires (14–10 AWG)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   * Use fish tape to pull conductors through the conduit

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   * Apply wire-pulling lubricant to reduce friction

2. Pulling with a Rope
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      * Attach a pull string or line to fish tape

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      * Use to pull larger wire bundles

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      * Tie conductors securely with basket grip or knot-and-tape methods

3. Mechanical Pulling
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         * Used for long runs or large conductors (e.g., 4 AWG and larger)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         * Use a motorized cable puller with appropriate pulling rope

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         * Monitor pulling tension to prevent conductor damage

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         * Use communication signals (hand signals or radios) between operators

________________


VI. Pulling Lubricants
Purpose:
Reduce friction, especially in long or tight conduit runs
Types:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Water-based lubricants – Easy to clean, used for indoor work

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Gel lubricants – Higher viscosity, used for long/vertical pulls

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Silicone-based lubricants – High-performance, low residue

Application:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               * Apply evenly to conductors before pulling

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               * Avoid over-lubrication which can make handling difficult

________________


VII. Best Practices
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Label wires before pulling for easier identification

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Pull in groups (not one at a time) to save time

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Use rollers or conduit feeders to support and align conductors

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Avoid excessive pulling force—refer to manufacturer’s tension limits

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Always ground metal conduit systems during pulling

________________


VIII. Safety Considerations
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Wear gloves and safety glasses

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Ensure circuit is de-energized before work

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Avoid pulling when conduit is wet or damaged

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Do not stand directly behind mechanical pullers

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Use pulling grips to avoid damaging conductor ends

________________


IX. NEC Guidelines Related to Pulling
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        * Max number of conductors must not exceed conduit fill limits (NEC Chapter 9)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        * Use proper support spacing for vertical cable runs

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        * Keep pull tensions within limits to preserve insulation integrity

                https://youtu.be/_dDuKCQP9Xc

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           * Practice proper teamwork—two-person method often most effective

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           * Mark conductor ends to prevent confusion after pulling

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           * Log all wire lengths and routes for documentation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           * Clean tools after use, especially when using lubricants

MODULE 6: Reading and Creating Electrical Drawings


Symbols and Abbreviations in Electrical Work
________________


I. Introduction
Symbols and abbreviations are standardized graphical representations and shortened forms used in electrical drawings, diagrams, and documentation. They allow electricians, engineers, and technicians to communicate complex information quickly, clearly, and universally.
________________


II. Importance of Symbols and Abbreviations
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Simplify complex diagrams for easier interpretation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Ensure consistency in documentation across projects and professionals.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Save space on drawings by avoiding lengthy descriptions.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Comply with industry standards (e.g., ANSI, IEC, NEC).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Facilitate effective communication among designers, installers, inspectors, and maintenance personnel.

________________


III. Common Electrical Symbols
Electrical symbols represent devices, equipment, wiring methods, and components on diagrams such as schematic diagrams, wiring diagrams, and single-line diagrams.

V. Standardization and References
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * ANSI (American National Standards Institute): Defines many electrical symbols and terminology.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * IEC (International Electrotechnical Commission): Provides international standards.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * NEC (National Electrical Code): Offers guidelines for electrical design and installation, including symbol usage.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * IEEE (Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers): Develops technical standards relevant to electrical engineering.

________________


VI. How to Read Electrical Diagrams Using Symbols and Abbreviations
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    1. Identify the legend/key: Most drawings include a legend explaining symbols and abbreviations.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    2. Understand line types: Solid, dashed, and dotted lines have different meanings (e.g., wiring, control, or reference lines).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    3. Follow flow direction: Arrows may indicate current or signal flow.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    4. Recognize grouping: Components grouped in panels or assemblies.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    5. Cross-reference: Match abbreviations with the symbol to identify components.

________________

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       * Grounding symbol (triangle or arrow to earth) connected to panel enclosure.
