                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Light Commercial: Employed in small office equipment, HVAC systems (e.g., exhaust fans, blowers), retail store displays, and light machinery (e.g., small compressors, conveyor belts).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Other Uses: Found in agricultural settings (e.g., irrigation pumps) and workshops (e.g., table saws, drill presses).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Power Supply (NEC 430.1):
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Operate on single-phase AC power, typically 120V for smaller motors (e.g., 1/4 HP–1 HP) or 240V for larger motors (e.g., 1–3 HP) in North America.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Compatible with standard residential and light commercial electrical services (e.g., 120/240V split-phase systems).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Voltage ratings may vary globally (e.g., 230V in some countries), requiring appropriate motor selection.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Horsepower Range:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Generally range from fractional horsepower (e.g., 1/6 HP for small fans) to approximately 3 HP for larger applications like air compressors or well pumps.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Larger single-phase motors (above 3 HP) are less common due to efficiency limitations and the preference for three-phase motors in higher-power applications.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Typical ratings: 1/4 HP, 1/2 HP, 3/4 HP, 1 HP, 2 HP, or 3 HP, depending on the load requirements.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Starting Mechanisms:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Single-phase motors lack a rotating magnetic field, requiring auxiliary means to initiate rotation:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Capacitor-Start Motors: Use a start capacitor to create a phase shift for high starting torque, ideal for loads with high inertia (e.g., compressors, pumps). The capacitor is disconnected via a centrifugal switch once the motor reaches speed (NEC 430.32).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Capacitor-Start/Capacitor-Run Motors: Include both start and run capacitors for improved efficiency and torque, used in HVAC systems and refrigeration.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Split-Phase Motors: Use an auxiliary winding with higher resistance to start, offering moderate torque for lighter loads (e.g., fans, blowers).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Shaded-Pole Motors: Employ a shading coil for low-torque, low-power applications (e.g., small fans, clocks), with no capacitor or switch.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Permanent Split Capacitor (PSC) Motors: Use a run capacitor continuously for smooth operation and efficiency, common in ceiling fans and small pumps.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Starting mechanisms impact motor performance, cost, and maintenance requirements.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Construction and Components:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Consist of a stator (with main and auxiliary windings), rotor (typically squirrel-cage type), bearings, and a housing (open or enclosed).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * May include thermal overload protection to prevent overheating (NEC 430.32).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Enclosures vary: Open Drip-Proof (ODP) for indoor use, Totally Enclosed Fan-Cooled (TEFC) for dusty or wet environments (NEC 430.16).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Efficiency and Performance:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Less efficient than three-phase motors due to single-phase power limitations, with efficiencies typically ranging from 60% to 80%.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Energy-efficient models (e.g., PSC motors with high-efficiency ratings) comply with standards like NEMA MG 1 or DOE regulations.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Power factor is lower than three-phase motors, often requiring capacitors to improve performance.
Installation Requirements (NEC Article 430):
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Wiring and Protection:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Conductors must be sized per NEC 430.22, typically 125% of the motor’s full-load current (FLC) from NEC Table 430.248 (e.g., 12A for a 1 HP, 120V motor).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Overcurrent protection (e.g., breakers, fuses) must comply with NEC 430.52, based on motor type and starting method (e.g., 250% of FLC for time-delay fuses).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Overload protection is required to protect the motor from overheating, typically via thermal relays or integral devices (NEC 430.32).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Grounding: An Equipment Grounding Conductor (EGC) must be provided to ground the motor frame, per NEC 250.122 and 430.242, using bare copper, green-insulated wire, or conduit (e.g., EMT).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Disconnecting Means: A disconnect switch or breaker must be within sight of the motor or lockable if remote, per NEC 430.102.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Conduit and Cable: Non-metallic (NM) cable is common in residential settings, while EMT or flexible conduit (FMC, LFMC) is used in commercial applications, per NEC Articles 348–358.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              * Location and Environment: Motors must be installed in environments matching their enclosure ratings (e.g., TEFC for wet locations, NEC 430.12).
                https://youtu.be/awrUxv7B-a8 
B. Types of Single-Phase Motors
Type
	Description
	Common Uses
	Split-Phase Motor
	Uses two windings (start and run); a centrifugal switch disconnects the start winding when the motor reaches ~75% speed.
	Fans, blowers, small pumps
	Capacitor-Start Motor
	Adds a capacitor to the start winding for higher starting torque.
	Compressors, refrigeration units, heavy-starting loads
	Capacitor-Start Capacitor-Run (CSCR)
	Uses a start capacitor for starting and a run capacitor for efficiency and smooth operation.
	Air conditioners, industrial machinery
	Shaded-Pole Motor
	Simple, low-torque motor with shaded-pole windings to create a rotating magnetic field.
	Small fans, microwave turntables
	Universal Motor
	Can run on AC or DC, very high speed, and high starting torque.
	Power tools, vacuum cleaners
	C. Characteristics of Single-Phase Motors
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * Less efficient than three-phase motors

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * Simpler wiring and cheaper control gear

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * May vibrate or have torque pulsations

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * Start winding or capacitor can fail over time
                https://youtu.be/7ivCYeF09h0 
________________


III. Three-Phase Motors
A. Overview
Three-phase motors are electric motors powered by a three-phase alternating current (AC) power supply, widely used in industrial and heavy commercial applications due to their efficiency, high power output, and robust performance. Unlike single-phase motors, three-phase motors generate a naturally rotating magnetic field, eliminating the need for auxiliary starting mechanisms. They are available in a wide range of horsepower (HP) ratings, from fractional HP to hundreds of HP, making them suitable for heavy-duty loads in diverse settings. The National Electrical Code (NEC, NFPA 70, 2023 edition) governs their installation and protection, primarily in Article 430, with additional requirements in Articles 250, 440, and 460 for specific applications.
Key Characteristics:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * Applications:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * Industrial: Used in manufacturing plants, factories, and processing facilities for equipment such as pumps, compressors, conveyors, fans, blowers, machine tools, and large HVAC systems.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * Heavy Commercial: Employed in large office buildings, hospitals, data centers, and retail complexes for elevators, chillers, air handlers, and escalators.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * Other Uses: Found in mining, oil and gas, water treatment, and agricultural facilities for high-power equipment like irrigation pumps, cranes, and hoists.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * Power Supply (NEC 430.1):
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * Operate on three-phase AC power, typically at voltages such as 208V, 240V, 480V, or 600V in North America, with 400V or 690V common in other regions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * Compatible with three-phase electrical services (e.g., 208Y/120V, 480Y/277V, or delta configurations), standard in industrial and commercial facilities.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * Three-phase power provides a constant power delivery, resulting in smoother operation compared to single-phase motors.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * Horsepower Range:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * Available in a broad range, from fractional HP (e.g., 1/2 HP for small fans) to very large ratings (e.g., 500 HP or more for industrial pumps or compressors).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * Common ratings include 1 HP, 5 HP, 10 HP, 25 HP, 50 HP, and up to 1000 HP for specialized applications like large centrifugal pumps or industrial drives.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * Larger motors are often custom-designed for specific applications, with ratings based on load requirements and efficiency standards.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * Self-Starting Mechanism:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * Three-phase motors produce a naturally rotating magnetic field due to the 120-degree phase difference between the three AC phases, eliminating the need for capacitors, auxiliary windings, or centrifugal switches.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * Common types include:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * Squirrel-Cage Induction Motors: Most common, with a rugged rotor design, high reliability, and low maintenance, used in pumps, fans, and conveyors.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * Synchronous Motors: Operate at constant speed, used in applications requiring precise speed control (e.g., synchronous drives, large compressors).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * Wound-Rotor Motors: Allow external resistance for starting torque control, used in high-inertia loads like cranes or mills.
