                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Wiring Harnesses: Verify connectivity in automotive, aerospace, or industrial harnesses to detect broken conductors or faulty crimps (NEC 110.14).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Fuses and Circuit Breakers: Confirm if a fuse is blown or a breaker is open (infinite resistance indicates failure, NEC 240.4).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Switches and Relays: Test for proper operation in control circuits (e.g., continuity when closed, open when off) for HVAC or motor starters.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Circuit Boards: Identify broken traces or failed solder joints in electronics or control panels.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Connectors and Terminals: Ensure secure, corrosion-free connections in junction boxes, panels, or fire alarm systems (NFPA 72, 14.4).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Cables: Verify end-to-end continuity in power, control, or communication cables (e.g., Cat6, NEC 800.24) before energization.
Additional Details:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Used during system commissioning to confirm wiring integrity before applying power (NEC 110.7).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Critical for troubleshooting non-functional circuits, such as lighting, fire alarms, or motor control circuits.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Supports predictive maintenance by identifying weak connections or potential faults before failures occur (NFPA 70B, 11.2).
F. Safety
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Avoid Live Circuits: Never test continuity on energized circuits to prevent electric shock, meter damage, or false readings (NFPA 70E, 120.5).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Verify De-Energization: Use a non-contact voltage tester to confirm zero voltage before connecting leads (NFPA 70E, 120.5(7)).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Inspect Test Leads: Check for damaged insulation, exposed conductors, or worn probes to avoid shock or short circuits (NFPA 70E, 130.7(D)).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Use Proper PPE: Wear insulated gloves and safety glasses when working near potentially live systems or in hazardous environments (NFPA 70E, 130.7).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Select CAT-Rated Tools: Use multimeters rated for the environment (e.g., CAT III 600V for branch circuits, IEC 61010-1).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Discharge Stored Energy: Ensure capacitors or inductive devices are discharged to prevent meter damage or shock (NEC 460.28).
Additional Details:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Follow lockout/tagout procedures to maintain a de-energized state during testing (OSHA 1910.147).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Store tools in protective cases to maintain calibration and prevent damage.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Train personnel on proper multimeter use and safety protocols to ensure compliance and accuracy.
