📚 Summary
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Continuing Education (CE/CPD): Mandatory learning for electricians to renew licenses, stay updated, and maintain safety and compliance.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Topics: Include SANS 10142-1/NEC updates, safety practices, renewable energy, and project management.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Formats: Available as in-person classes, online courses, webinars, or manufacturer training, but must be accredited.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Benefits: Keeps licenses active, enhances skills, and opens career opportunities, ensuring compliance with OHSA, SANS 10142-1, and NEC.
Additional Details:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * In South Africa, CPD is critical for ECB registration and CoC issuance, aligning with national safety and energy goals.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Digital platforms streamline CE/CPD tracking, with costs ranging from R500–R2,000 per course (2025 estimates).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Compliance with NFPA 70E, OHSA, and local bylaws ensures safe and legal electrical work.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     * Regular CE keeps electricians competitive in a rapidly evolving industry, from smart homes to renewable energy.
